title: The Map That Learned to Breathe
summary: Urban cartographer Emi crosses Shinjuku from dawn to neon, following data lines until a city of 14 million becomes one breathing human map.

fields.director_notes: Directed with MiniMax M3.1 Flash (model minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash via SandBase API). Brief: Turn Shinjuku into an isometric pixel-art journey from dawn to night across 8 mapped landmarks. Built using pixel-iso-city, MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD narration, real OpenStreetMap building footprints, heights, and roads, rendered via isometric canvas engine.
fields.my_city_line: Tokyo: a blue line through fourteen million lives.
